Hello I ordered a bsb30 batch 1 order-Shop····

I’m wondering if I can swap for a magic miner 40th.
Note to the team: I'll pull the order up before answering.

Hi Jeff,

Yes, we can do that, but let me give you the dates first so you can decide.

Your B30 on Shop···· is batch 1 and ships October 15, so it's about a week out. The Magic Miner 40T that's open right now is Batch 7, and that one isn't in stock today, it's a pre-order that ships by November 30. You can follow both shipments on their way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On the money, the 40T is $100 less than the B30 line on your order, and $100 back goes to your account as store credit, which applies at checkout on your next order. Your free Power Kit stays on the order either way.

So it's 30 TH/s next week, or 40 TH/s at the end of November with $100 in credit. Just reply yes if you want the swap and I'll make the change today and send you the updated order. If you'd rather have the $100 back on your card instead of as credit, say so and I'll pass that to a colleague to sort out.

Thanks Jeff,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Jeff,

Sorry for the slow reply, you should have had this answer on Monday.

Here is where things stand. Your B30 on Shop···· is batch 1 and ships October 15, so it is right at the front of the queue now. The Magic Miner 40T that is open at the moment is Batch 7, and that one is not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026. You can follow both shipments on their way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On the money, the 40T comes out $100 under the B30 line on your order. That $100 goes back as store credit on your account, which applies automatically at checkout on your next order. Your free Power Kit stays on the order either way.

So it is 30 TH/s shipping this week, or 40 TH/s at the end of November with $100 in credit. Both are good units, and the 40T is the better value per TH if the extra wait does not bother you.

Just reply yes and I will make the swap the same day and send you the updated order. If you would rather have the $100 back on your card than as store credit, tell me and a colleague will pick that part up tomorrow from 10am ET and confirm it by email.

Thanks for your patience, Jeff.
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
